# ContextOS 2.7.2 — Focused work, explicit outcomes, inspectable evidence

Release preparation is in progress. Functional checks pass; performance qualification is pending. This draft does not claim complete-task savings.

ContextOS gives coding agents focused source and compact verification receipts. This update adds merged source context to search, clear mutation outcomes, scoped ownership preservation, read-only diagnosis for invalid saved graphs, and complete parser-asset installation checks. The shorter skill uses native tools for small repairs and reads existing failure receipts directly.

The real-task evaluation uses `gpt-6-luna` / `max`, serial fresh workspaces, primary provider usage, independent repair checks, regression tests, and cumulative budgets. Small tasks and interrupted runs remain in the data. Controlled response-only percentages from 2.7.1 are separate from completed development-task measurements.

[Evaluation](https://github.com/yubinbin32-ops/ContextOS/blob/codex/real-development-evaluation/docs/DEVELOPMENT_QUALIFICATION.md) · [中文说明](https://github.com/yubinbin32-ops/ContextOS/blob/codex/real-development-evaluation/README_zh.md)

Requires Node.js 22+. Start a new chat after updating an installed plugin. Complete standalone archives must include the server bundle, parser runtime and grammars; final release assets and checksums will be verified before publication.

If these receipts help your development workflow, [star ContextOS](https://github.com/yubinbin32-ops/ContextOS) and contribute a reproducible task benchmark. Measurements where it costs more are welcome.

## Unreleased lean refactor

Hub and cloud deployment are removed; local metadata migration preserves local data and configuration backups. The main skill permits focused OS or native work without mandatory graph governance.

Generic CLI Micro adapters join the existing Key/API transport. Keep both, switch CLI-first/API-first priority, inject bounded task manifests, and independently verify implementation work in a separate workspace. Usage retains provider/cache/reasoning semantics and supports a configurable personal relative-cost divisor. Unknown billing and failed tasks remain visible.

The live AGY Flash/high analysis and bounded implementation tasks passed, including independent regression and scope checks. Earlier implementation attempts were denied before editing and their cost is retained; other CLIs require their own adapter validation. Complex-task savings remain unqualified. Windows frontend builds pass; the new Windows native settings bridge still needs Windows validation. Complete-task performance qualification remains pending. [Accounting and limitations](https://github.com/yubinbin32-ops/ContextOS/blob/codex/lean-micro-refactor/docs/MICRO_COST_ACCOUNTING.md).
